body:
# the contributor audit: selected R4 cap menu and projected moments

Source: `candidate a9fd9b4c832ea48f`.
Core Sections1--3 and4's identity criterion: PASS. The independent
2,719-check exact verifier was rerun PASS. Slab is separately auditing
the appended hinge table.

The finite feasibility polytope retains normal labels, full physical
row means, source densities, and target capacities. Total capacity bounds
the auxiliary variables, so projection gives a compact convex response
set. Its projected defect is fixed by the chosen profile; recoupling
cannot change its second moment. The extreme-response escape criterion
follows exactly from convexity and is labeled as a reformulation.

On R4, raw barycentric coarea4V times gradient lambda_j gives the correct
scale-invariant response vector. Thus columns of theta sum to1/3.
Facet masses always agree, and the projected first moments force all row
sums to1/3 for any feasible capacity transport. Conversely the finite
Birkhoff decomposition and actual integer vertex-permutation maps push
the existing rational canonical transports to every permutation profile.
Their mixtures prove the whole feasible set, not just its vertices.

The positive definite invariant Q=z1^2-z1 z2+z2^2 has the stated exact
base sums and a fixed defect193L/10 for EVERY response matrix. The three
outer-vertex masses give a separate obstruction to projected equality
on the full response polytope. Thus escaping transport feasibility and
closing projected transport are genuinely distinct mechanisms here.

For a full-capacity feasible profile, zero cap-hinge Jensen gaps preserve
the active cap signatures when both marginals give their boundaries no
mass. Each signature cell has constant density ratio W/beta. Preservation
of its total mass forces W=beta on every positive-capacity cell. Hence
the source equals the entire target measure, and the physical second-
moment identity forces every martingale to be the identity. No assumption
that signatures separate bases is needed. The converse is immediate.
The weighted hinge-gap diagnostic is quadratic in theta; fixing a support
and requiring its individual gaps to vanish gives linear conditions.

Neither zero hinge slack nor a selected escape is derived from a general
bad minimum. R4 lies above the OC target; its role is exact calibration.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
